title: Word Output Record Contract
purpose: Define the final bounded record that will later replace or feed generated/word-of-day.json only after output connector approval.

governed_publication_contract.note: This is an output projection, not another content bank. Existing AG63 preview fields are never a publication source.

prepared_public_delivery.cache_policy: no-store for browser and CDN; no stale or conditional responses
prepared_public_delivery.rollover_policy: fresh IST date on every request; withhold if midnight occurs during the read
prepared_public_delivery.public_copy_policy: allowlisted reviewed copy and approval references only; no ledger, drafts or review notes
